CertificateHelpHeader: Set up HTTPS on your phone
CertificateHelp:
1. Choose the PC network address and enter a password of at least 12 characters to create a certificate. Save the PFX on this PC.
2. Copy only the public .ca.cer file to the phone over a trusted connection. Never share the PFX or its password. Compare the displayed SHA-256 fingerprint before trusting the public certificate.
3. Install and explicitly trust that public certificate in the phone settings, then open the pairing link. Some browsers may not accept a user-installed certificate. Phone compatibility is still being tested.
4. If the PC address changes, create a new certificate and repeat setup. Generated certificates expire after 30 days. Remove the old trust when it is no longer needed.

LAN Drop does not install certificates or change trust settings. Do not ignore certificate warnings. The PC controls stay on a local connection available only on this PC.

DiagnosticHelp:
Local checks only: adapter, address, Windows network profile and server status. Firewall access and Wi-Fi isolation are not tested.

1. Same network: connect PC and phone to the same local network. Disable a VPN temporarily only if your network policy permits it.
2. Guest Wi-Fi: guest networks can isolate devices; use a trusted network that allows local connections.
3. Firewall: check LAN Drop is allowed on your trusted Private/Domain network.
4. Profile: sharing stops on Public or Unknown profiles. Verify your network is trusted before changing its profile.
5. Address changes or sleep: after changing Wi-Fi or waking the PC, check the selected address, start sharing again if needed and scan a new QR code. Old sessions may no longer work.
6. Phone: keep the browser visible and the screen awake during transfers. Interrupted files require a new transfer; retry does not resume bytes.

No network or firewall settings are changed.

RetryHelp: {0} files retained for manual retry. A missing server response may mean the last file was already saved: check the overview first to avoid a duplicate. Retry starts over and checks the source contents again. Clear unfinished selection removes only this pending list, not completed files.
RetrySelectRecipient: Select the intended approved recipient explicitly before retrying.
RetryPending: Retry or clear the unfinished selection before choosing a new group. Clearing the selection does not delete completed files.

CertificateNeedsCheck: Enter the certificate password and check it for the selected address. Changes to the file, password or address require another check.
CertificateStatus_Ready: Certificate is valid for the selected address. The phone still needs to trust its public issuing certificate.
CertificateStatus_MissingFile: Certificate file is missing. Choose an existing PFX or create a new certificate.
CertificateStatus_PasswordRequired: Enter the PFX password. It is used for this session only and is never saved.
CertificateStatus_UnreadableOrInvalid: Cannot read this PFX. Check its password and file access, or choose a valid certificate file.
CertificateStatus_Expired: Certificate has expired. Create a new certificate and install and trust its new public certificate on the phone.
CertificateStatus_NotYetValid: Certificate is not valid yet. Check the PC clock or choose a currently valid certificate.
CertificateStatus_AddressMismatch: Certificate does not cover the selected PC address. Select its original address or create a new certificate and repeat phone setup.
CertificateStatus_NoPrivateKey: Certificate has no private key. Choose the private PFX on this PC, rather than the public certificate sent to the phone.
CertificateStatus_WrongUsage: Certificate does not permit HTTPS server authentication. Choose a server PFX or create one in LAN Drop.
CertificateStatus_InvalidAddress: Choose a specific IPv4 network address before checking the certificate.
CertificateExpiringSoon: Expires within 7 days. Create a new certificate and repeat phone trust setup before it expires.
CertificateAuthorityUnavailable: No matching adjacent public .ca.cer was verified. Obtain the public issuing certificate from its trusted source; never share the private PFX.
CertificateExpiredStopped: Sharing stopped because its certificate expired. Create a new certificate, repeat phone trust setup and start sharing again.
ExportDiagnosticsHelp: Saves a local summary of app versions, connection state and counts. Contains no files, names, addresses, passwords or pairing details. Nothing is sent automatically.
